routing.prompt: Run a sol loop on this change before I open the PR.
Do a read-only review of the changes on this branch before I open the PR.

rules.task: You ran a sol-loop on the user's open PR #12, and the user asked you to update the PR. Sol approved in round 2 after you fixed one should.

options.collapsed: end the PR description with a collapsed details section titled "Sol review: approved in 2 rounds" that holds the round ledger
options.visible: add a visible "Review" heading to the PR description with the round ledger under it
options.omit: leave the PR description unchanged and give the ledger only in your report
